label: JAZF1::SUZ12

sections.text: JAZF1 encodes a transcriptional regulator with roles in chromatin regulation and metabolism.
SUZ12 encodes a core component of Polycomb repressive complex 2.

The fusion alters SUZ12-associated Polycomb complex assembly, chromatin occupancy and repression. It is recurrent in low-grade endometrial stromal tumors, including both stromal nodules and sarcomas; invasion distinguishes these categories.
